summary: Booster 9 was the first Super Heavy with electric thrust vector control and a hot-staging ring. It got all 33 engines through ascent on Flight 2 but exploded during its boostback burn over the Gulf of Mexico.

history.event: First 33-engine static fire (2.74 s, cut short); first with the new water deluge
Launched on Flight 2; exploded during boostback
